text_blocks.snippet: Gengar-EX is a prominent Psychic-type Pokémon-EX card in the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG), most notably featured in the XY—Phantom Forces era as well as later iterations like Temporal Forces.
snippet_highlighted_words: a prominent Psychic-type Pokémon-EX card in the Pokémon Trading Card Game (TCG)

list.snippet: Weakness / Resistance / Retreat Cost: Psychic ×2 / Fighting -20 / Retreat Cost 2
Night Attack: Costs 1 energy; puts 3 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
Dark Corridor: Costs 3 energy (2 colorless, 1 psychic); deals 60 damage, leaves your opponent’s Active Pokémon Poisoned, and switches Gengar-EX with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Dark Corridor: Costs 3 energy (2 colorless, 1 psychic); deals 60 damage, leaves your opponent’s Active Pokémon Poisoned, and switches Gengar-EX with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Rule Box: When a Pokémon-EX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
XY—Phantom Forces #34 (Regular Art): Typically ranges from about $21 (Played) to $50–$80+ for Near Mint copies, with graded collector copies reaching higher values via PriceCharting.
XY—Phantom Forces #114 (Full Art): Commands a higher collector market value, often ranging from $200+ in played conditions up to $500–$765+ for Near Mint status through platforms like TCGplayer.

Scarlet & Violet: Temporal Forces (#104 / #193): Newer Gengar ex prints from Temporal Forces generally retail around $7 to $60 depending on the specific variant (Double Rare vs. Ultra/Special Art Rare).
